author: Matt Lenzie
upstream_repository_access: Private; public reproducibility begins from included aggregate inputs.json
scope: The curated specialist cohort records 13 active lenders in both Q3 2025 and provisional Q3 2026, while the top-five share rises from 58% to 64%. The current share remains below Q1 (68%) and Q2 (66%). Q3 records 207 charges across 140 borrowers, or 1.48 charges per borrower. This report separates breadth, concentration and charge intensity. Registered charges are not loan amounts or verified new loans, and the wider property-funding ecosystem is not a development-loan total.
reproduction: python reproduce.py --output reproduced; standard library only. Does not rebuild upstream ETL or independently recalculate retained source statistics.
no_private_entities: No lender names, security trustees, company numbers, borrower records, addresses or transaction-level records included.
